verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a local inference runtime, so cold-start speed is a fair axis. The evidence only says it ships as 'one binary' and can preload models. Nothing documents a fast cold start or how long it takes before inference begins, and preloading is a different control from startup speed.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
